scope: Four technical runs on one Grid, two fixed curricula and two initializations; not MHU architecture evidence.
hypotheses_are: marginal, overlapping diagnostic explanations; not an exhaustive exclusive partition
prior_scale: ordinal, subjective; no numerical probabilities elicited

H-R1.proposition: Insufficient coverage of sources by role and their local configurations materially limits transfer under the fixed training budget.
H-R1.support_weak: In both seeds, BALANCED minus UNIFORM UU accuracy >=0.10, with BALANCED train and SS >=0.98.
H-R1.contradict_weak: In both seeds, BALANCED minus UNIFORM UU accuracy <=-0.10, while UNIFORM train and SS >=0.98.
H-R1.otherwise: neutral_or_inconclusive; if both curricula reach ceiling, the contrast cannot identify the proposed cause
H-R1.limit: The treatment is a curriculum-construction package; marginal exposure, ordering of chosen contexts and relational statistics are not independently manipulated.

H-R2.proposition: The learned selection rule transfers to new combinations of sources previously exposed in their relevant role in both curricula, but remains dependent on the support of source/context configurations. Shared swapped anchors additionally expose each SS source in both roles.
H-R2.support_weak: BALANCED train and SS >=0.98 in both seeds, but BALANCED UU <0.98 in both seeds.
H-R2.contradict_weak: BALANCED train, SS and UU >=0.98 in both seeds.
H-R2.limit: Source novelty is accompanied by remaining geometric differences; equal queries and hops do not equal all path and mixing statistics. This pattern does not prove memorization of IDs.

H-R3.proposition: The current GGNN/interface/optimization regime does not learn selection reproducibly even for new combinations of exposed sources under the fixed budget.
H-R3.support_weak: BALANCED SS <0.98 in at least one seed; label a one-seed failure as initialization instability and a two-seed failure as reproducible transfer failure.
H-R3.contradict_weak: BALANCED train and SS >=0.98 in both seeds, regardless of UU.
H-R3.otherwise: neutral_or_inconclusive; a UU-only failure is represented by H-R2, while successful SS contradicts this narrower known-source transfer defect
H-R3.limit: Does not establish intrinsic incapacity, missing information or a unique architecture versus interface cause.

update_policy.eligibility: All four expected runs COMPLETE, finite and exactly 250 updates; source/config/data identities unchanged.
update_policy.ineligible: No evidential update for resource limits, numerical failures or incomplete/missing panels; preserve all records.
update_policy.method: One ordinal update per hypothesis from the same joint experiment package; no Bayes factors or manufactured numerical posterior.
update_policy.correlation: Accuracy, BCE, Jacobians and flips belong to the same package; never multiply them as independent evidence.
update_policy.replication: Two initializations share one fixed panel pair and one geometry; no general population effect or confirmatory inference.

stop_policy: BALANCED is the primary candidate fixed before scores. Its two seeds must have finite final train, SS and UU >=0.98. Failure closes this intervention; no extension, seed/panel winner selection or extra training. Passing does not execute XOR or MHU automatically.
